Production PIXEL ART for the existing Sproto fighting game. Crisp stepped pixels, dark outlines, compact limited-color shading. Not smooth vector or painterly art. Each cell contains exactly ONE complete actor facing RIGHT, consistent three-quarter side view. Preserve the reference identity, facial shape, exact eye count, colors, clothing, accessories and the individually specified curvy or chubby body shape. Same head, torso and limb proportions in every frame. Exactly two arms and two legs per actor, legs rooted at the LOWEST pelvis below the belly. Low hip, chambered knee and connected ankle for every kick. Never attach legs to the chest. Keep all limbs and feet wholly inside their own cell with generous empty margins; no clipping. Flat solid pure MAGENTA #ff00ff background, no grid lines, labels, shadows, trails, floating particles or weapons. Worn/held identity accessories must remain attached to body or hand. Extend cropped lower bodies conservatively using matching skin/clothing colors and simple shoes. Complete separate body drawings; no limb cutouts. Both feet need readable soles. No extra subjects.

IDENTITY: ONLY the BACK LEFT adult female cartoon figure: round blue head, large yellow half-lidded eyes with black pupils, broad red lips. Preserve a clearly curvy adult silhouette like the source: narrower waist, substantially wider rounded hips, fuller upper torso, fuller thighs. No slender athletic build. Keep her blue face, red body palette and recognizability. Exclude the front pointed figure. The attached sheet is the NEW approved body-shape design. Copy its exact head/body scale and proportions in every drawing, never the old thin build. Only this one actor in every cell; partner has separate animation sheets. Red character: pronounced waist, fuller upper torso, broad rounded hips and fuller thighs; opaque red costume. Blue character: prominent rounded belly and thicker legs/arms. Preserve ONLY the corresponding character's revised shape in every pose.

No feet crossing through one another, no sliding torso, no detached hips. Each frame has at least one clearly grounded foot. Last frame loops to first. Same complete body and clothing as the combat reference.
